critique_titles: Bots use dead hitscan carbine (weapon.js/traceShot) while players use dodgeable projectiles — two damage economies
Saber is a free third slot: per-weapon Charge means Q-swap refills, leafblade soak 100 in an 86-degree cone with no cost
MatchSim._hit validates only distance and a 120 clamp — no weapon, cooldown or charge authority; botEv spoofs sender
Melee has commitment but zero counterplay: no block/parry/dash, and right-mouse is unused while the blade is out
one_big_idea: The Duel Triangle: right-mouse GUARD on the saber deflects projectiles back at their owner (Guard beats Shot), swings break guard with a 0.9s stagger (Swing beats Guard), arcs zone the approach (Shot beats Approach) — plus one shared Focus meter across the loadout.

directives.title: Unify the resource — one shared Focus meter
directives.acceptance: Q-spamming across slots yields no extra total shots; charge bar continuous across swaps; empty Focus blocks the blade swing

directives.title: Ship the Duel Triangle — guard, deflect, guard-break
directives.acceptance: Held guard bounces an incoming bubble and a deflected projectile can down its original owner; swing into a guard deals 0 damage and staggers 0.9s; guard drops at empty Focus

directives.title: Delete the ghost carbine and give the server weapon authority
directives.acceptance: No references to traceShot/Magazine/WEAPON remain; a forged 120-damage leafblade hit from 20m is rejected; bot shots are dodgeable projectiles

challenge_for_mikel: Is the Verdant Blade a universal third slot or a CLASS? Commit to Blade vs Petal class picks at match start, or accept a soup where everyone holds everything. Director's vote: Blade vs Petal.
